findings.detail: Important, below Critical; reported under the explicit production deadline exception. Pipeline stages check their execution deadline before a potentially blocking journal append, then launch without checking again. For a 12-second pipeline allocation, the worker execution deadline is 3 seconds and its journal-lock deadline is 6 seconds. A command-record append beginning at 2 seconds and acquiring its lock at 5 seconds therefore launches the stage after execution has expired, consuming the reserved worker cleanup interval. The enclosing supervisor does not begin shutdown until 6 seconds. The immediate pre-Popen expiry correction must cover this sibling launch path too.
findings.evidence: checked_core.py:1052 gives the worker journal cleanup_deadline. Lines 1199-1201 check deadline and then append the command record; Popen at line 1203 has no intervening expiry check. pipeline_command supplies worker_deadline and execution_deadline as those two deadlines at lines 1287-1288. allocate() derives their respective offsets as 3 and 6 seconds for timeout=12.
findings.title: Parallel paths: pipeline stages can launch after their execution deadline

findings.detail: Important, below Critical; reported under the explicit verdict-classification exception. Nested unittest output still determines the outer verdict when printed outside an exception report. A passing outer test can print a captured nested skip report to stdout and finish with its own successful unittest summary on stderr. matches concatenates both streams, and framework_lines treats both reports as outer summaries because neither contains an exception separator. The nested skipped=1 then rejects the valid outer control. This contradicts the approved rule that nested runner output never supplies excluded statuses.
findings.evidence:
For a complete exit-0 result, let stdout contain '-----
Ran 1 test in 0.001s

OK (skipped=1)
' and stderr contain '-----
Ran 1 test in 0.001s

OK
'. Both summaries satisfy lines 138-146; report_start is None at line 148; lines 154-155 return an empty status list for the nested skip. Thus matches rejects a green expectation containing '
OK
'. The added regression covers nested reports only after an exception separator.
findings.title: Sibling input forms: nested reports outside tracebacks still control verdicts
